summary: This dataset describes a research project aiming to improve retinal prostheses for patients with outer retinal degeneration. Current retinal prostheses have limitations, including low spatial resolution and temporal control, which result in low-quality artificial vision. The proposed project will investigate intraretinal electrodes positioned within the inner nuclear layer to overcome these limitations, with the goal of achieving 20/160 vision, and will involve measuring RGC responses, optimizing multichannel intraretinal stimulation, and verifying long-term functionality and biocompatibility of a high-density carbon fiber array.
